# Mixxx Personal: personal fork

This is Jonathan DeLeon's personal experimental fork of [Mixxx](https://github.com/mixxxdj/mixxx), based on Mixxx 2.5.6, for use with [Platter One](https://github.com/jdd059/platter-one). It is independently maintained and is not an official Mixxx release.

The [personal build branch](https://github.com/jdd059/mixxx/tree/personal/manual-midi-rescan) adds:

- **Rescan MIDI Devices** in Preferences > Controllers, so newly connected MIDI devices can be discovered without restarting
- A build with external Audio Unit and LV2 effects disabled to skip external plugin scanning while keeping built-in effects
- A separate **Mixxx Personal** app and copied personal profile

See [personal build and setup instructions](https://github.com/jdd059/mixxx/blob/personal/manual-midi-rescan/PERSONAL_BUILD.md). The small Finder launcher depends on the full app built inside the checkout; it is not a standalone distribution.

Thank you to the Mixxx developers, controller mapping authors, translators, testers, and wider community for building and maintaining the software that makes this experiment possible. All of the core DJ and audio functionality comes from their work. Please visit the [upstream project](https://github.com/mixxxdj/mixxx), [official downloads](https://mixxx.org/download/), and [donation page](https://mixxx.org/donate/).

The original Mixxx README follows below, with its documentation and credits preserved.

# Mixxx

[Mixxx] is Free DJ software that gives you everything you need to perform live
DJ mixes. Mixxx works on GNU/Linux, Windows, and macOS.

## Quick Start

To get started with Mixxx:

1. For live use, [download the latest stable version][download-stable].
2. For experimentation and testing, [download a development release][download-testing].
3. To live on the bleeding edge, clone the repo: `git clone https://github.com/mixxxdj/mixxx.git`

## Bug tracker

The Mixxx team uses [Github Issues][issues] to manage Mixxx development.

Have a bug or feature request? [File a bug on Github][fileabug].

Want to get involved in Mixxx development? Assign yourself a bug from the [easy
bug list][easybugs] and get started!

## Building Mixxx

Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for build instructions, code style
guidelines, and how to open a pull request.
